name: lekhanam
description: A local book writing tool for macOS

scripts.build:apple-ai: swiftc resources/apple-ai-cli/main.swift -parse-as-library -module-name AppleAICLI -o resources/apple-ai-cli/apple-ai-cli && chmod +x resources/apple-ai-cli/apple-ai-cli
scripts.dist: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron-rebuild && npm run build:apple-ai && npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron-builder --mac --arm64 && npm run staple
scripts.dist:mas: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron-rebuild && npm run build:apple-ai && npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron-builder --config electron-builder-mas.yml && bash scripts/sign-mas.sh
scripts.dist:test: npm run build:apple-ai && npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config.mac.notarize=false --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.staple: V=$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('./package.json').version)") && codesign --sign "Developer ID Application: Anish Varghese (65UF42MSBU)" --timestamp dist/Lekhanam-$V-arm64.dmg && xcrun notarytool submit dist/Lekhanam-$V-arm64.dmg --keychain-profile "lekhanam-notary" --wait && xcrun stapler staple dist/Lekhanam-$V-arm64.dmg && xcrun stapler validate dist/Lekhanam-$V-arm64.dmg

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lekhanam uses your microphone to transcribe your speech into text as you write. For example, you can dictate a paragraph out loud and it will be inserted directly into your chapter. All audio is processed entirely on your Mac using on-device speech recognition — nothing is recorded or sent to any server.
